1	import { useCallback } from 'react'
2	import { IconQuestionOutlineRegular } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives'
3	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
4	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/types'
5	import type { InjectFace, PropsLocale } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'
6	// Also merges the userQuestions key into SessionProjectionMap for useProjection.
7	import type {
8	  AskUserQuestionAnswerItem, AskUserQuestionItem, AskUserQuestionOption,
9	} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions/types'
10	import type { ToolCallViewProps, UserQuestionRecord } from '../../contract/slots.ts'
11	import type { AskQuestionCardModel } from '../models/ask-question-card-model.ts'
12	import { singleResultText } from '../models/raw-tool-call.ts'
13	import { toolRowModel } from '../models/tool-call-model.ts'
14	import { ToolRow } from '../components/ToolRow.tsx'
15	import { QuestionToolRow } from '../components/QuestionToolRow.tsx'
16	import { CONVERSATION_NS as NS } from '../../locale.ts'
17	
18	/** One paired question and its visible answer lines. */
19	interface AnsweredQuestion {
20	  id: string
21	  question: string
22	  answers: string[]
23	}
24	
25	/** Everything a recorded answer batch puts on its row. */
26	interface AnswerPresentation {
27	  summary: string
28	  /** The paired transcript card; absent when pairing the batch would be ambiguous. */
29	  transcript: AskQuestionCardModel | null
30	  /** Material for the read-only panel; absent whenever the transcript card is, since both render the same pairing. */
31	  record: UserQuestionRecord | undefined
32	}
33	
34	function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
35	  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
36	}
37	
38	function parseJson(text: string): unknown {
39	  try {
40	    return JSON.parse(text)
41	  } catch {
42	    return undefined
43	  }
44	}
45	
46	/** Answer records from the result JSON; null when the result is malformed. */
47	function answerEntries(text: string): AskUserQuestionAnswerItem[] | null {
48	  const parsed = parseJson(text)
49	  if (!isRecord(parsed)) return null
50	  const answers = parsed.answers
51	  if (!Array.isArray(answers) || !answers.every(isRecord)) return null
52	  const entries: AskUserQuestionAnswerItem[] = []
53	  for (const answer of answers) {
54	    if (typeof answer.id !== 'string'
55	      || !Array.isArray(answer.selected)
56	      || !answer.selected.every(item => typeof item === 'string')
57	      || (answer.custom !== undefined && typeof answer.custom !== 'string')) return null
58	    entries.push({
59	      id: answer.id,
60	      selected: answer.selected,
61	      ...(answer.custom === undefined ? {} : { custom: answer.custom }),
62	    })
63	  }
64	  return entries
65	}
66	
67	/** Answers from a submitted steer that still awaits admission to a step. */
68	function queuedAnswerEntries(message: unknown, callId: string): AskUserQuestionAnswerItem[] | null {
69	  if (!isRecord(message) || !Array.isArray(message.content)) return null
70	  const content: unknown = message.content[0]
71	  if (!isRecord(content) || content.type !== 'text' || typeof content.text !== 'string') return null
72	  const parsed = parseJson(content.text)
73	  if (!isRecord(parsed) || parsed.kind !== 'answer_to_pending_question' || parsed.callId !== callId) return null
74	  return answerEntries(content.text)
75	}
76	
77	/** One question's choices from call JSON; absent when any entry is malformed. */
78	function optionEntries(value: unknown): AskUserQuestionOption[] | undefined {
79	  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return undefined
80	  const options: AskUserQuestionOption[] = []
81	  for (const option of value) {
82	    if (!isRecord(option) || typeof option.label !== 'string') return undefined
83	    options.push({
84	      label: option.label,
85	      ...(typeof option.description === 'string' ? { description: option.description } : {}),
86	    })
87	  }
88	  return options
89	}
90	
91	/**
92	 * Questions from call JSON; null when pairing with answers would be ambiguous.
93	 * The optional presentation fields are carried for the read-only answer panel,
94	 * which renders the same option lists the user chose from; a malformed one is
95	 * dropped rather than failing the whole call, because the transcript card needs
96	 * only the id and the question text.
97	 */
98	function questionEntries(argsRaw: string): AskUserQuestionItem[] | null {
99	  const parsed = parseJson(argsRaw)
100	  if (!isRecord(parsed) || !Array.isArray(parsed.questions) || parsed.questions.length === 0) return null
101	  const questions: AskUserQuestionItem[] = []
102	  const ids = new Set<string>()
103	  for (const question of parsed.questions) {
104	    if (!isRecord(question)
105	      || typeof question.id !== 'string'
106	      || typeof question.question !== 'string'
107	      || ids.has(question.id)) return null
108	    ids.add(question.id)
109	    const options = optionEntries(question.options)
110	    questions.push({
111	      id: question.id,
112	      question: question.question,
113	      ...(typeof question.header === 'string' ? { header: question.header } : {}),
114	      ...(typeof question.detail === 'string' ? { detail: question.detail } : {}),
115	      ...(options === undefined ? {} : { options }),
116	      // The tool schema spells the multi-select flag in snake case.
117	      ...(typeof question.multi_select === 'boolean' ? { multiSelect: question.multi_select } : {}),
118	    })
119	  }
120	  return questions
121	}
122	
123	/** Pair questions with result entries by their echoed stable ids. */
124	function pairAnswers(
125	  questions: readonly AskUserQuestionItem[],
126	  answers: readonly AskUserQuestionAnswerItem[],
127	): AnsweredQuestion[] | null {
128	  if (questions.length !== answers.length) return null
129	  const byId = new Map<string, AskUserQuestionAnswerItem>()
130	  for (const answer of answers) {
131	    if (byId.has(answer.id)) return null
132	    byId.set(answer.id, answer)
133	  }
134	  const paired: AnsweredQuestion[] = []
135	  for (const question of questions) {
136	    const answer = byId.get(question.id)
137	    if (answer === undefined) return null
138	    paired.push({
139	      id: question.id,
140	      question: question.question,
141	      answers: [
142	        ...answer.selected,
143	        ...(answer.custom === undefined || answer.custom === '' ? [] : [answer.custom]),
144	      ],
145	    })
146	  }
147	  return paired
148	}
149	
150	/**
151	 * Answer summary, transcript content, and panel material from one recorded
152	 * answer batch, whether the result carried it in time or a late reply did.
153	 * @param questions - The call's questions, or null when they failed validation.
154	 * @param answers - The recorded answer batch.
155	 * @param t - Row translator.
156	 * @returns What the answered row shows.
157	 */
158	function answeredPresentation(
159	  questions: readonly AskUserQuestionItem[] | null,
160	  answers: readonly AskUserQuestionAnswerItem[],
161	  t: AskQuestionRowProps['t'],
162	): AnswerPresentation {
163	  const answered = answers.filter(answer => answer.selected.length > 0 || (answer.custom ?? '') !== '').length
164	  const paired = questions === null ? null : pairAnswers(questions, answers)
165	  return {
166	    summary: t('ask.answered', { answered, total: answers.length }),
167	    transcript: paired === null ? null : { kind: 'answered', questions: paired, skippedLabel: t('ask.skipped') },
168	    // The read-only panel renders the option lists the user chose from and
169	    // looks each answer up by question id, so a batch this row cannot pair
170	    // unambiguously gets no panel either: blank or dropped answers would read
171	    // as choices the user made.
172	    record: paired === null || questions === null ? undefined : { questions, answers },
173	  }
174	}
175	
176	/** Best-effort answered-count summary when strict transcript pairing fails. */
177	function answeredSummary(text: string, t: AskQuestionRowProps['t']): string | null {
178	  const parsed = parseJson(text)
179	  if (!isRecord(parsed)) return null
180	  const answers = parsed.answers
181	  if (!Array.isArray(answers) || !answers.every(isRecord)) return null
182	  const answered = answers.filter(a =>
183	    (Array.isArray(a.selected) && a.selected.length > 0)
184	    || (typeof a.custom === 'string' && a.custom !== '')).length
185	  return t('ask.answered', { answered, total: answers.length })
186	}
187	
188	/** Whether a successful tool result records a still-answerable timed question. */
189	function isPendingResult(text: string): boolean {
190	  const parsed = parseJson(text)
191	  return isRecord(parsed) && parsed.pending === true && typeof parsed.callId === 'string'
192	}
193	
194	/** Injected panel verbs for the row's own Session, filled by the optional panel provider. */
195	interface AskQuestionPanelInjected {
196	  /**
197	   * Show one call's answer panel in the composer.
198	   * @param callId - the row's own `ask_user_question` call.
199	   * @returns whether a panel for that call was there to show.
200	   */
201	  revealPanel: (callId: string) => boolean
202	  /**
203	   * Show one settled call's recorded answers as a read-only panel.
204	   * @param callId - the row's own `ask_user_question` call.
205	   * @param record - the call's questions and recorded answers, read from this row.
206	   * @returns whether a panel provider was there to show it.
207	   */
208	  reviewPanel: (callId: string, record: UserQuestionRecord) => boolean
209	}
210	
211	type AskQuestionRowProps = ToolCallViewProps & PropsLocale<'conversation'> & InjectFace<AskQuestionPanelInjected>
212	
213	/** Summarizes a pending, answered, cancelled, or interrupted question set. */
214	export function AskQuestionRow({
215	  callId, toolName, block, inspect, useDisclosure, useProjection, revealPanel, reviewPanel, t,
216	}: AskQuestionRowProps) {
217	  const model = toolRowModel(toolName, block)
218	  // The `userQuestions` projection lists exactly the timed calls that can still
219	  // take an answer — the running ones and the ones the agent continued past —
220	  // so it, not the recorded result, decides whether this row offers its panel.
221	  // A recorded pending result stays recorded after the reply, the skip, or the
222	  // timeout lands, and a legacy blocking call is never listed: its row reads
223	  // exactly as it did before timed questions existed.
224	  const answerable = useProjection('userQuestions', view =>
225	    view?.active.some(row => row.callId === callId) ?? false)
226	  // The same projection settles every answered timed call with its batch: the
227	  // one its own result carried, or the one a late reply carried after the
228	  // result recorded the timeout. A legacy call is never settled there, so its
229	  // answers come from its result text alone, without a panel to read back.
230	  const settled = useProjection('userQuestions', view =>
231	    view?.settled.find(row => row.callId === callId))
232	  // A continued call stays answerable until its steered reply is admitted.
233	  // Select the durable Inbox entry so its submitted answers can be reviewed
234	  // read-only during that interval, including after a browser reconnect.
235	  const queuedReply = useProjection('inbox', (view) => {
236	    const matches = (message: unknown): boolean => {
237	      const source = isRecord(message) ? message.source : undefined
238	      return isRecord(source) && source.kind === 'user-question-reply' && source.callId === callId
239	    }
240	    return view?.['next-step'].find(matches) ?? view?.['next-turn'].find(matches)
241	  })
242	  const reopen = useCallback(() => revealPanel(callId), [callId, revealPanel])
243	  // Composer verdicts settle the call as specific UserQuestionErrors
244	  // (ask_user_question handler): 'ASK_CANCELLED' is the user's own
245	  // dismissal of the set, 'ASK_ABORTED' is a turn interrupt landing while the
246	  // question was pending. Both name their verdict instead of the generic
247	  // failed shape, and the abort keeps the shared stopped (amber) semantics of
248	  // any other interrupted tool call.
249	  const code = 'kind' in block ? block.error?.code : undefined
250	  const argsRaw = model.bodyRaw ?? ''
251	  let summary = model.summary
252	  let state = model.state
253	  let transcript: AskQuestionCardModel | null = null
254	  // An answerable call reopens its panel, a queued reply reveals the row's
255	  // read-only transcript, and a settled call opens a read-only panel.
256	  let rowAction: (() => boolean) | undefined
257	  let rowActionLabel = t('ask.reopen')
258	  if (code === 'ASK_CANCELLED') {
259	    summary = t('ask.cancelled')
260	    state = 'ok'
261	    const questions = questionEntries(argsRaw)
262	    if (questions !== null) {
263	      transcript = { kind: 'unanswered', questions, verdict: t('ask.cancelledDetail') }
264	    }
265	  } else if (code === 'ASK_ABORTED') {
266	    summary = t('ask.interrupted')
267	    state = 'stopped'
268	    const questions = questionEntries(argsRaw)
269	    if (questions !== null) {
270	      transcript = { kind: 'unanswered', questions, verdict: t('ask.interruptedDetail') }
271	    }
272	  } else if (model.state === 'running') {
273	    summary = t('ask.waiting')
274	    if (answerable) rowAction = reopen
275	  } else if (code === 'TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' && (answerable || settled !== undefined)) {
276	    // Crash repair has no pending result text; the durable question projection
277	    // still knows whether the interrupted call can take a late answer.
278	    state = 'ok'
279	    const questions = questionEntries(argsRaw)
280	    if (answerable) {
281	      summary = t('ask.pending')
282	      if (questions !== null) transcript = { kind: 'unanswered', questions, verdict: t('ask.pendingDetail') }
283	      rowAction = reopen
284	    } else if (settled?.answers.length === 0) {
285	      summary = t('ask.closed')
286	      if (questions !== null) transcript = { kind: 'unanswered', questions, verdict: t('ask.closedDetail') }
287	    } else if (settled !== undefined) {
288	      const presentation = answeredPresentation(questions, settled.answers, t)
289	      summary = presentation.summary
290	      transcript = presentation.transcript
291	      const record = presentation.record
292	      if (record !== undefined) {
293	        rowAction = () => reviewPanel(callId, record)
294	        rowActionLabel = t('ask.review')
295	      }
296	    }
297	  } else if ('kind' in block && model.state === 'ok') {
298	    const text = singleResultText(block)
299	    if (text !== undefined) {
300	      const questions = questionEntries(argsRaw)
301	      // A timed question's recorded result may be the timeout; whether it is
302	      // still answerable, and what the user finally answered, is the
303	      // projection's to say.
304	      const pending = isPendingResult(text)
305	      if (pending && answerable) {
306	        summary = t('ask.pending')
307	        if (questions !== null) {
308	          transcript = { kind: 'unanswered', questions, verdict: t('ask.pendingDetail') }
309	        }
310	        rowAction = reopen
311	      } else if (pending && (settled === undefined || settled.answers.length === 0)) {
312	        summary = t('ask.closed')
313	        if (questions !== null) {
314	          transcript = { kind: 'unanswered', questions, verdict: t('ask.closedDetail') }
315	        }
316	      } else {
317	        // Answered either way: whether the answer beat the timeout is the
318	        // agent's pacing, not something a reader of the row has to reason
319	        // about, so a late-answered call reads exactly like an in-time one.
320	        const answers = settled?.answers ?? answerEntries(text)
321	        const presentation = answers === null ? null : answeredPresentation(questions, answers, t)
322	        // Full transcripts require stable ids and valid visible fields; retain the
323	        // legacy best-effort count when only strict pairing is unsafe.
324	        summary = presentation?.summary ?? answeredSummary(text, t) ?? model.summary
325	        transcript = presentation?.transcript ?? null
326	        // Only a timed call has a panel to read its answers back in.
327	        const record = settled === undefined ? undefined : presentation?.record
328	        if (record !== undefined) {
329	          rowAction = () => reviewPanel(callId, record)
330	          rowActionLabel = t('ask.review')
331	        }
332	      }
333	    }
334	  }
335	  if (answerable && queuedReply !== undefined && rowAction === reopen) {
336	    const answers = queuedAnswerEntries(queuedReply, callId)
337	    const presentation = answers === null ? null : answeredPresentation(questionEntries(argsRaw), answers, t)
338	    if (presentation?.record !== undefined) {
339	      summary = presentation.summary
340	      transcript = presentation.transcript
341	      // The panel registry still owns an editable card until admission. Let
342	      // QuestionToolRow reveal this immutable transcript instead.
343	      rowAction = () => false
344	      rowActionLabel = t('ask.review')
345	    }
346	  }
347	  if (rowAction !== undefined) return (
348	    <QuestionToolRow useDisclosure={useDisclosure} t={t} summary={summary}
349	      bodyRaw={transcript === null ? model.bodyRaw : null} output={transcript === null ? model.output : null}
350	      askQuestion={transcript} state={state} inspect={inspect}
351	      openPanel={rowAction} panelLabel={rowActionLabel} />
352	  )
353	  return (
354	    <ToolRow
355	      useDisclosure={useDisclosure}
356	      t={t}
357	      variant={model.variant}
358	      toolName={toolName}
359	      icon={<IconQuestionOutlineRegular />}
360	      title={t(model.titleKey)}
361	      summary={summary}
362	      bodyRaw={transcript === null ? model.bodyRaw : null}
363	      output={transcript === null ? model.output : null}
364	      askQuestion={transcript}
365	      state={state}
366	      inspect={inspect}
367	    />
368	  )
369	}
370	
371	/** Registers the ask-user-question conversation row. */
372	export const askQuestionToolview = {
373	  name: 'ask-question-toolview',
374	  inject: ['slots'],
375	  apply(ctx: Context): void {
376	    ctx.slots.inject('tool.call.toolview', () => ctx.slots.register({
377	      name: 'tool.call.toolview', key: 'ask_user_question', locale: NS,
378	      // Read per click, not per render: a composition with no question UI
379	      // provides no panels, and the row then falls back to its own record.
380	      inject: (sessionId): AskQuestionPanelInjected => ({
381	        revealPanel: callId => ctx.get('userQuestionPanels')?.reveal(sessionId, callId) ?? false,
382	        reviewPanel: (callId, record) =>
383	          ctx.get('userQuestionPanels')?.review(sessionId, callId, record) ?? false,
384	      }),
385	    }, AskQuestionRow))
386	  },
387	}
